j-P19f: Hear the child even when the accused is someone people love. Communities fail here, because the adult may be charismatic, useful, rich, spiritually important, or everybody's friend. Decide on the response process ahead of time, before anyone's face is attached to it. Keep the child and anyone else at risk safe first, right away, then make sure the accusation is investigated competently and fairly. Nobody's status buys silence.
